Maintainer note on the "Review config compatibility" item: this was raised from a truncated file inventory (`unknown-truncated-pull-files`), not from a detected change. There is no config, schema, or persisted-format change in this PR:

- No `src/config` types, defaults, or Doctor/migration files change. The only `src/config` path is a worker test, and the only `*schema*` path is the storage-changes doc entry.
- `subagent_runs` keeps its columns and its serialized `payload_json` format. The row version used for compare-and-set is a SHA-256 computed from the existing stored payload and indexed columns, so no revision column is added.
- Upgrade: rows written by older builds are read and versioned as-is. Downgrade: rows written by this build use the same format, so an older build reads them unchanged. Existing-schema compatibility tests cover both directions of reading.
- Runtime incarnation keys are process-local and never persisted.

So the compatibility impact is none; the remaining merge blocker was the conflict with main, which is being resolved.
